verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an error chart that shows error frequency and trends, deployment tracking that surfaces new errors or regressions, and ordering of errors by occurrences with version filters. That covers volume over time and per-release regressions within an application. There is no evidence of cross-project or cross-team leadership dashboards, so this is partial. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, a dedicated top-regressions view, an explicit new-issues-per-release report, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time

citations.quote: Added **error chart** visualization to **search results page**. Provides visual insight into error frequency and trends.
Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences, and use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.
